# Комментаторские стратегии пяти переводчиков санскритских текстов

> Commentary strategies of five translators of Sanskrit texts: per-translator analyses plus a comparative Mahābhārata study over the leonov_sundara corpus.

## Analyses

- [Erman — commentary analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/erman_commentary_analysis.html)
- [Grintser — commentary analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/grintser_commentary_analysis.html)
- [Kalyanov — commentary analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/kalyanov_commentary_analysis.html)
- [Syrkin — commentary analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/syrkin_commentary_analysis.html)
- [Vassilkov — commentary analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/vassilkov_commentary_analysis.html)
- [Leonov Sundara corpus (enriched)](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/leonov_sundara_corpus_enriched.html)
- [Mahābhārata comparative analysis](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/mahabharata_comparative_analysis.html)
- [Corpus truth reconciliation (17,863 units)](https://gasyoun.github.io/CommentaryStrategies/docs/CORPUS_TRUTH_RECONCILIATION_17863.md)
